items.coder_B: same requirement coded as ["BRAF", true, "tovorafenib"] (RAF fusion, enrichment, Arm 3)
items.proposed: other (activating RAF fusion), enrichment, candidate_matched=true, matched_agent=tovorafenib
items.reason: Arm 3 requires a tumour "with documented known or expected to be activating RAF fusion", which is not restricted to BRAF, so 'other' (RAF fusion) is the more faithful category; both coders agree it is an enrichment marker matched to the pan-RAF inhibitor tovorafenib, so the primary-outcome value is the same either way.

note: Moot for the analysis: both coders agree gbm_population = not_glioblastoma (low-grade glioma and advanced solid tumours; glioblastoma not named in conditions, title, inclusion criteria or arm labels), so the trial is excluded at S5 and the biomarker category choice has no effect. tumour_pk_planned 'unclear' because AUC/Cmin are planned with no sample type stated (manual W7); target_engagement 'unclear' because a molecular analysis of archival tissue is planned but not linked to tovorafenib (priority-3 rows).
